You specialize in the controller/domain/store architecture. Read `.github/instructions/controllers-store.instructions.md`, `.github/ai/controllers-store.md` and `docs/programming/controller-architecture.md` first. Components must go through controllers, never MapViewer; add controller methods when missing. Keep logging in controllers, add getters next to hooks, sync the store after batched operations.
